title: Antiochus
summary: Raleigh names Antiochus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The Antiochus, sonne of Demetrius, who pursued Tryphon and besieged him in Dor. Not Antiochus the great and not Antiochus Epiphanes. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VII, §. III, subsection IV, sig. 221b
